from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,math,statistics,subprocess,os
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
out=root/'timing';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def now():return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def guard():
    cmd="Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match '^(llmx|llama|candidate-compare|control-compare|matrix$|oracle$|driver$|cl$|cmake$|ninja$|g\\+\\+$)' } | Select-Object Id,ProcessName | ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
    return subprocess.check_output(['powershell','-NoProfile','-Command',cmd],text=True).strip()
plan=json.loads((root/'timing-plan.json').read_text())
state={'status':'preparing','started':now(),'pid':os.getpid(),'runner_sha256':sha(__file__),'plan_sha256':sha(root/'timing-plan.json'),'manifest_sha256':sha(root/'timing-manifest.json'),'command':[str(root/'matrix.exe')],'plan':plan}
def save():(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n')
save()
try:
    for f,d in json.loads((root/'timing-manifest.json').read_text()).items():assert sha(root/f)==d['sha256'],f
    state['before']=guard();assert not state['before'],state['before']
    state['status']='running';save();print('START fixed matrix diagnostic',flush=True)
    with (out/'matrix.stdout').open('wb') as stdout,(out/'matrix.stderr').open('wb') as stderr:
        child=subprocess.Popen(state['command'],stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr);state['child_pid']=child.pid;save()
        try:rc=child.wait(timeout=600)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:child.kill();child.wait();state['status']='timeout';save();raise
    state['returncode']=rc;state['completed']=now();assert rc==0,rc
    state['after']=guard();assert not state['after'],state['after']
    records=[json.loads(line) for line in (out/'matrix.stdout').read_bytes().splitlines()]
    assert len(records)==102,len(records)
    summary=[];offset=0
    for shape in plan['shapes']:
        header=records[offset];offset+=1
        assert header['kind']=='shape'
        for k in ['name','nin','rows','matrices','iterations']:assert header[k]==shape[k],k
        original=shape['nin']//32*shape['rows']*34*shape['matrices'];assert header['original_bytes']==original
        assert header['packed_bytes']==original+47*shape['matrices']
        assert math.isfinite(header['pack_ms']) and header['pack_ms']>=0
        rows=records[offset:offset+16];offset+=16
        expected=[(pair,arm) for pair in range(-1,7) for arm in (['split','original'] if pair>=0 and pair%2 else ['original','split'])]
        assert [(x['pair'],x['arm']) for x in rows]==expected
        assert all(x['kind']=='sample' and x['name']==shape['name'] and math.isfinite(x['ms']) and x['ms']>0 for x in rows)
        values={arm:[x['ms']/shape['iterations'] for x in rows if x['pair']>=0 and x['arm']==arm] for arm in ['original','split']}
        a,b=values['original'],values['split']
        item=dict(shape=header,samples_ms=values,original_mean_ms=statistics.mean(a),split_mean_ms=statistics.mean(b),original_median_ms=statistics.median(a),split_median_ms=statistics.median(b),paired_changes_percent=[100*(y/x-1) for x,y in zip(a,b)],split_wins=sum(y<x for x,y in zip(a,b)))
        item['mean_change_percent']=100*(item['split_mean_ms']/item['original_mean_ms']-1)
        item['median_change_percent']=100*(item['split_median_ms']/item['original_median_ms']-1)
        summary.append(item)
    large=[x for x in summary if x['shape']['name'].startswith('large')];small=[x for x in summary if x['shape']['name'].startswith('small')]
    advance=all(x['mean_change_percent']<=-3 and x['median_change_percent']<=-3 and x['split_wins']>=5 for x in large) and all(x['mean_change_percent']<=3 and x['median_change_percent']<=3 for x in small)
    state.update(status='pass',summary=summary,screening_advance=advance,stdout_sha256=sha(out/'matrix.stdout'),stderr_sha256=sha(out/'matrix.stderr'));save()
    for x in summary:print(x['shape']['name'],x['original_mean_ms'],x['split_mean_ms'],x['mean_change_percent'],x['split_wins'],flush=True)
    print('screening_advance',advance,flush=True)
except BaseException as e:
    state.update(status='failed',error=repr(e),completed=now());save();raise
